cases.translation: God's ark remains in a tent.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) indicating location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Господь дал ему покой от каждого ___.
cases.translation: The Lord gave him rest from every enemy.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: Go and tell my servant David.
cases.explain: The dative case marks the recipient of a command or message.

cases.sentence: Я не жил в ___ с того дня.
cases.translation: I have not lived in a house since that day.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.translation: I took you from the pasture.
cases.explain: The preposition с (from) when indicating source or origin governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Я сокрушил перед тобой всех твоих ___.
cases.translation: I have crushed all your enemies before you.
cases.explain: The accusative case marks the direct object of a transitive verb.

cases.sentence: Я уподоблю твое ___ именам великих людей земли.
cases.translation: I will make your name like the names of the great ones of the earth.
cases.explain: The accusative case marks the direct object after the verb уподоблю.

cases.sentence: Чтобы ему иметь свой ___ и никто его больше не тревожил.
cases.translation: That they may have their own dwelling place and be disturbed no more.
cases.explain: The nominative case is used for the predicate nominative after the infinitive быть.

reading.ru: Смотри, я живу во дворце из кедра, а Божий ковчег остается в шатре.
reading.question: What contrast does the king make about their dwellings?
options: He lives in a cedar palace while God's ark is in a tent
The king lives in a tent and God's ark in a palace
reading.correct: He lives in a cedar palace while God's ark is in a tent
reading.explain: The king observes that he has built himself a grand cedar palace, but God's ark remains in a simple tent.

reading.ru: Я не жил в доме с того дня, как вывел израилетян из Египта, и до сегодняшнего дня, но странствовал в шатре и в скине.
reading.question: How long has God been living without a permanent house?
options: Since the exodus from Egypt until now
reading.correct: Since the exodus from Egypt until now
reading.explain: God says He has not lived in a house from the time He brought Israel out of Egypt until that day.

reading.ru: Я взял тебя, когда ты смотрел и ухаживал на пастбище за овцами, чтобы ты стал правителем моего народа Израиля.
reading.question: What was David doing before becoming the ruler?
reading.explain: God reminds David that He took him from the pasture where he was tending sheep to make him ruler.

reading.ru: Я уподоблю твое имя именам великих людей земли.
reading.question: What does God promise to make David's name like?
options: The names of the great ones of the earth
reading.correct: The names of the great ones of the earth
reading.explain: God promises to make David's name as great and renowned as the names of the greatest people on earth.

reading.ru: Я устрою место для своего народа Израиля и укореню его, чтобы ему иметь свой дом, и никто его больше не тревожил.
reading.question: What will God establish for the people of Israel?
options: A permanent place and security so no one will disturb them
A place to gather for only one year
reading.correct: A permanent place and security so no one will disturb them
reading.explain: God promises to appoint a place for Israel and plant them so they have their own home and are not troubled anymore.

reading.ru: Когда твои дни завершатся, и ты упокоишься со своими предками, я возведу на престол твоего потомка.
reading.question: What will happen after David's life ends?
options: God will set one of David's descendants on the throne
God will choose a stranger to rule
reading.correct: God will set one of David's descendants on the throne
reading.explain: God promises that when David's days are complete, He will set up one of David's offspring after him on the throne.
